spec_match.rationale: Runs both real shapes: the legacy top-level requestStorageAccessFor(origin) call and the replacement requestStorageAccess() invoked from an embedded iframe context.

interactive.rationale: Editable target origin plus try-legacy / try-modern buttons with live result panes for each.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers exactly the promised side-by-side of legacy vs replacement.

edge_cases.rationale: Removed-method, rejection, cross-origin contentDocument denial, and iframe load timeout all produce distinct honest messages (rejection and timeout both observed in the headless run).

references.rationale: Links ChromeStatus feature 5162221567082496 and MDN requestStorageAccess.

conformance.rationale: Covered by the new v153 feature suite (removal + surviving replacement surfaces).

runtime_evidence.rationale: Feature harness run passed desktop+mobile after final edits (screenshots read). CDP sweep: legacy → 'rejected: NotAllowedError — requestStorageAccessFor not allowed'; modern → honest 'iframe load timed out' in the sandboxed environment; zero console errors/exceptions.

telemetry_health.rationale: Shared demo-telemetry shell active; both result panes render explicit outcome text for diagnosis.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables throughout; legacy/modern panes use accent-rose/accent-emerald only for headings on stone backgrounds (AA-compliant).

accessibility.rationale: Labelled origin input, native buttons, and textual result panes; layout is flex-wrap with no keyboard traps.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; panes stack at narrow widths via flex-wrap (flex-basis 16rem).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive migration wizard step tabs without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use wrapping flex/grid with intrinsic minimum sizes so comparison panes stack instead of overflowing on narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The legacy/modern panes keep flex: 1 1 16rem so they stack on mobile; harness confirmed no horizontal overflow.

summary: v153 refile of migration-lab for the Chrome 153 removal rollout: milestone references and legacy-code comments updated. Verified via the responsive harness and a CDP sweep of both try buttons with zero console errors.
